capture_lineage: Selected delivery prefixes are those identified by the primary DELIVERY-INDEX. final-11 captures precede some final interaction/renderer repairs; final-episode-04 and final-dark-episode record scroll-away/return/stop after repair, final-growth-02 records compact growth, and final-build/final-current.png is the final built product capture personally viewed by primary. Earlier/failed captures and reports are retained separately in the complete snapshot, not silently discarded.
all_original_evidence: The byte-complete input/overlay reconstruction also retains baseline, research, failed attempts and captures outside this final-product index.
